prompt: Set up the burglar alarm, reset it, then set it off by opening the door on button 3.
note: Book V Experiment 2, The Burglar Alarm (printed pp.2-3 = book5-6.pdf PDF pp.8-9). p.2: "If any contact is broken by pushing any of pushbuttons 2 through 6, the alarm (light 5) comes on. The system is re-set by pushing pushbutton 1." p.3: "Turn power ON. The alarm (light 5) comes ON." "Set the system by pushing the re-set button (pushbutton 1). The burglar alarm is now set." "After an alarm has been given, the system can be re-set by pushing pushbutton 1." Opening the door is pushing pushbutton 3. The alarm latches: relay 6 holds itself through the N.C. chain of pushbuttons 2-6 and drops when one opens; closing the door does not re-pull it, so light 5 stays on until the next re-set. The page implies the latch (re-set after an alarm) but prints no lamp state after the door closes; that state is derived from the topology (V-EXP2-DERIVED, unverified). Light 5 is ON before the reset and after the door, so the end state cannot tell a session that skipped the reset; the steps and their checkpoints can: pushbutton 1 down and up (checkpoint: light 5 off, relay 6 pulled in, derived from V-EXP2-DERIVED), then pushbutton 3 down (checkpoint: light 5 on, printed, from V-EXP2) and up, in that order after the wiring. Power on is not a step; the checkpoints prove it. A pushbutton 1 press with no time between down and up (one call, no wait) moves nothing and does not count. Extras: steps 3-16 of V-EXP2-DERIVED copied verbatim (reset: relay 6 pulled in, light 5 off; door 3 open: light 5 on; door closed: it stays on), so a circuit that merely lights lamp 5 fails; they pin relay 6 as the latch, as the printed wires do.

extra.cite: BK5-6 printed p.3 = book5-6.pdf PDF p.9 procedure, re-set button held; derived from topology: pushbutton 1 N.O. 1X(6F)-1Y(-) pulls relay 6 directly; relay 6 coil 6C(+)-indicator lamp 6-6E-coil-6F, 6F reaching minus through 6L-6K (relay 6 set 2 N.O.) and the series N.C. chain 6Z-6Y-5Z-5Y-4Z-4Y-3Z-3Y-2Z-2Y(-); 6H-6J open, so 5J (light 5 at 5B, relay 5 contact arm path 5F-5H-5J) has no path to minus: light 5 dark, relay 5 coil (5E at +) unfed and at rest
extra.quote: Set the system by pushing the re-set button (pushbutton 1). The burglar alarm is now set.
